readme.name: DandyPicker
readme.note: Plan usage is off by default. Turning it on reads each profile's sign-in token and sends it to api.anthropic.com only; see [Plan usage](#plan-usage-off-by-default).

captions.grow: the profiles grow in, one after another
captions.sway: hover a plant and it sways
captions.customize: color, waviness, stem bend and seed tips
captions.code: the seeds spell the profile's name and folder

folders.src: the app: Avalonia on .NET 10; the plants are PlantView.cs and Plant.cs
folders.tools: the icon maker, and readmotion/: the config, demo profiles and driver that record this README's media

features.title: Several accounts at once
features.text: Each profile is its own Claude Desktop with its own data folder, so work and personal run side by side, each signed in.

features.title: Each profile is a plant
features.text: It grows from the profile's name and folder: the seeds spell them out, and no two plants grow alike.

features.title: Plan usage at a glance, if you want it
features.text: Opt in to see each profile's session and weekly usage as rings round its flower.

features.title: Sign-in hand-off
features.text: It catches the `claude://` sign-in link from your clipboard and sends it to the profile that asked.
